metadata.question: Does the total number of lakes in northern Siberia east of the Taz River decrease in 2002 compared to 1973?

data.raw_code:
```python
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Approximate region for 'northern Siberia east of the Taz River'
# The Taz River is west of the Yamal Peninsula. East of the Taz River would include
# parts of Yamal-Nenets Autonomous Okrug and further east.
# A bounding box is used for simplicity and to avoid complex river definitions.
# This box covers an area generally east of the Taz River's mouth into the Ob Bay,
# extending eastward into northern Siberia.
geometry = ee.Geometry.BBox(77.0, 66.0, 95.0, 72.0) # Approx long/lat for northern Siberia east of Taz

# Target years
year_1973 = 1973
year_2002 = 2002

# The core constraint: "Use the latest Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance datasets only"
# LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2 (starts 1982)
# LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2 (starts 1984)
# LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2 (starts 1999)
# LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 (starts 2013)
# LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2 (starts 2021)

# Reviewing the available Landsat C2 L2 datasets:
# - Landsat 4 starts in 1982.
# - Landsat 5 starts in 1984.
# - Landsat 7 starts in 1999.
# - Landsat 8 starts in 2013.
# - Landsat 9 starts in 2021.

# None of these collections cover the year 1973.
# This makes it impossible to answer the question using the specified data source.

print(f"Question requires data for {year_1973} and {year_2002}.")
print("Per instruction: 'Use the latest Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance datasets only'.")
print("Available C2 L2 datasets and their start years:")
print("- Landsat 4 (LT04): starts 1982")
print("- Landsat 5 (LT05): starts 1984")
print("- Landsat 7 (LE07): starts 1999")
print("- Landsat 8 (LC08): starts 2013")
print("- Landsat 9 (LC09): starts 2021")
print(f"Data for year {year_1973} is not available in any of the specified Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 datasets.")

# Therefore, an empty collection will be encountered for 1973.
print("C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).")
print("C1")
```
